verdict.rationale: USCIS's online account and tools could plausibly offer AI-generated insights, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only static filing tips, a fee calculator, and a questionnaire that presents eligibility options. None of these is documented as AI-generated analysis or suggestions drawn from the user's own data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
